description: Have RepuTend track another business on your account, by its domain (such as example.com): on Trustpilot, or on another review site (G2) when profile gives the business's address there. RepuTend takes your word that the business is yours. From then on RepuTend reads its low-star reviews and screens each one. A business another RepuTend account tracks can't be added. On the Standard plan each business is billed every month, so the first call changes nothing and answers the price with a confirmation: show the person the confirmation, wait for their yes, then call again with the same business and profile, the quote_id and a new idempotency_key you keep for retries. What a person may say: "add example.com to RepuTend".

account.description: The account to act for, by its owner's email or the domain of a business it tracks, as list_businesses shows them. Needed only when you're on more than one account's team.

business.description: The business's domain, such as example.com.

idempotency_key.description: With quote_id: a unique value you choose for this confirmation and keep; a retry with the same value answers the first result.

profile.description: The business's profile address on Trustpilot or G2; its Trustpilot profile when omitted.

quote_id.description: On Standard: the quote_id of the price the person said yes to.
